blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists may see gasoline prices fall by as much as P4.20 a liter next week, while an increase in diesel prices may be expected, an industry source said. Gasoline prices may likely be cut by P4 to P4.20 a liter for the week of Oct. 19, while diesel may likely increase by P0.20 to P0.40 a liter.
